text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! Ahahaha~!
1st place!! We did it~~!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: The moment I crossed the finish line was amazing~!! The crowd went wild, and my whole body was tingling☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Smiles everywhere, this way and that☆
Everyone was able to become Marvelous★☆★

Let's share it like this! Then the whole world
is sure to sparkle with Marvelous☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"The next race will be Marvelous too☆
Reach out to the world! Marve-loooous★☆★"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, you're right☆
Still not enough~★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
To make the whole world sparkle,
we need waaay more Marvelous, right? ☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
That's why I gotta get even, eeeven stronger!!
So I can bring Marvelous to the whole wide world! ☆
